start: Admin app, Members, Import page; a wrong Excel file was imported today into Crispy Curves

steps.action: Open the Import page and find the import under 'Past imports'
user_sees: The import listed with its date and an 'Undo this import' button
must_not: Imports of another branch mixed into this list

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import' and confirm
user_sees: The members, plans, memberships and receipts that import made are gone from the lists
must_not: A member typed in by hand removed
A receipt removed with no line in the receipt history

steps.action: Open Money for today
user_sees: Totals lowered by the undone receipts
must_not: Undone receipts still counted as money in

start: Import ended with members saved but not all their plans and payments

steps.action: Read the message on the Import page
user_sees: 'Members are saved, but not all their plans and payments. ... Tap “Undo this import” below. Then import the same file again, so every payment comes in only once.'
must_not: A message with no way to take the half import back

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import' below the message
user_sees: The half import removed
must_not: Records of an earlier good import removed

steps.action: For a branch import: switch to that branch and open the same page
user_sees: That branch's own 'Past imports' list with its undo button
must_not: The undo run against the wrong branch

start: An old or tampered admin app asks the server to delete a member who was typed in by hand

steps.action: Send the delete for the hand-typed member
user_sees: The save refused (server answer INVALID); the member stays
must_not: The hand-typed member deleted
The refusal sent again and again

steps.action: A front-desk session sends a delete for an imported member
user_sees: 'Only an owner can do this.'
must_not: The imported member deleted by the front desk

steps.action: Import the same file again
user_sees: Members, plans and payments come back once each
must_not: Payments counted twice
The old undone records shown again beside the new ones

steps.action: The front desk tries to save one of the undone receipts again
user_sees: 'Only an owner can do this.'
must_not: An undone receipt brought back by the front desk

steps.action: Open the receipt history
user_sees: A line for each undone receipt: when, who, 'removed'
must_not: The front desk able to open the history

steps.action: Ask what happened to the undone members' data
user_sees: unknown: the server keeps the taken-back rows with their data (marked deleted); no screen says so
must_not: Aadhaar or PAN numbers among the kept data
